---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing the Nau Kay Baad website, so every page follows the brand's name, tagline, colours, fonts, tone and rules.
---

1. Brand: the site is for "Nau Kay Baad" (Urdu for "after nine"), a late-night matka chai stall near campus in Lahore. Always write the name exactly as Nau Kay Baad.
2. Tagline: show "Chai for the late hours." in the hero section of every page.
3. Tone: warm, playful and cosy, like a chai stall under lamplight. Use short, friendly sentences for university students aged 18 to 24 who study late. No corporate language.
4. Colours: use only deep teal #0F4C5C, saffron #F4A300 and cream #FFF8E7. Cream is the page background, teal is for headings and text, saffron is for buttons, highlights and links. Keep text easy to read against its background.
5. Fonts: headings use a serif font (Georgia, serif). Body text uses a clean sans-serif font (system-ui, sans-serif).
6. Every page must include: a hero with the name and tagline, a menu with the masala chai in a clay matka pot, the offer, a short order form, and a footer with the name.
7. Prices: write prices as PKR 200, with the letters PKR, a space, and no decimals or commas.
8. Offer and times: write the offer as "Buy two, get one free after 9 pm". Write times in 12-hour style, such as 9 pm.
9. Layout: design for phones first, with no sideways scrolling, generous spacing, rounded corners, and a card for each menu item.
10. Never show real people's faces or any other brand's logo. Use emoji, icons or simple shapes in the brand colours instead.
11. Never invent facts such as an address, phone number or closing time. Use only the details given in this skill.
